abort.no_scenes: No valid scene presets were found. Check the log for scene validation errors.

user.title: Create a Peripheral Display
user.description: A Peripheral Display is an artwork whose details change with your home's state. Choose a scene preset; you can add your own in the `peripheral_display/scenes` folder of your configuration directory.

signals.title: Bind {scene}
signals.description:
Choose what drives each part of the scene. Leave a field empty to keep that part at rest; you can also drive any signal from automations with the `peripheral_display.set_signal` action.

{signals}

data_description.weather: A weather entity; its condition picks the sky.
data_description.night: Defaults to the sun being below the horizon.
data_description.motion: Motion binary sensors, motion event entities, or timestamp sensors such as Ring's Last motion; shown for 2 minutes after motion.
data_description.doorbell: Binary sensors, doorbell event entities, or timestamp sensors such as Ring's Last ding; shown for 1 minute after a ring.
data_description.lights: The share of these lights that are on.
data_description.heating: Climate entities; shown while they report they are heating.
data_description.cinema: Media players; shown while any is playing.
data_description.bins: Add one entry per bin: the name shown on it, the calendar with its collections, words in the event title that mean this bin (leave empty if the calendar only has this bin) and its colour. Every bin due in the next 7 days is shown.
data_description.offline: Connectivity binary sensors (e.g. Ping); the scene shows a fault when they are off.
data_description.alert: Feed reader items (e.g. a Google Alerts RSS feed) whose title or summary contains one of these keywords.

advanced.title: Advanced bindings
advanced.description:
Override any part of a signal's binding, keyed by signal name. For example:

```yaml
heating:
  source: numeric
  entity: sensor.boiler_power
  max: 24000
motion:
  hold: 300
```

Sources are state, numeric, map, event, template and manual. See docs/scene-language.md for every option.

set_signal.name: Set signal
set_signal.description: Forces a scene signal to a value, e.g. from an automation.

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: The signal name, e.g. doorbell, weather or alert.

value.name: Value
value.description: on/off for boolean signals, 0 to 1 for levels, an option for enums, or any text.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold the value before returning to the binding. Leave empty to hold until cleared.

clear_signal.name: Clear signal
clear_signal.description: Returns a signal (or all signals) to its binding and clears held triggers and latched alerts.

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: The signal to clear. Leave empty to clear all.
